title: Approved learnings were global (applied to every project) and memory was write-only

rcca.root_cause: learnings had one global store injected unconditionally; no project/area scope and memory was never read back.
rcca.corrective: project-scoped learnings store + need-based render(project,area) union; learning_synth applies project scope; opt-in bounded memory read-back.
rcca.preventive: Default scope project/area; global is explicit; injection bounded+need-based; single writer; static contract intact.
